question: Does the fixed six-ETF trend/relative-strength/inverse-volatility thesis decision policy improve a complete net-cost buy-hold-reduce-exit account over the original frozen f0 and fixed controls without tuning the already inspected history?

feeProfile.assumptionLabel: 最低5元为模拟假设，以合同为准

fixedCandidate.trend: previous completed HFQ close > MA60 and momentum20 > 0
fixedCandidate.ranking: momentum20 / annualized population volatility20; symbol tie break
fixedCandidate.allocation: top 3, inverse annualized volatility; 100-share lots; original Fee default and adverse slippage
fixedCandidate.planBudget: no unfilled sale proceeds or slots; <=12500 and <=25% equity; retain T1 lots
fixedCandidate.exit: original raw 4% risk /20 sessions/pending exit then thesis invalid or rank/target reduction; no predictive profit target
fixedCandidate.addLots: separate original fees and next-session availability, inherit earliest remaining maturity
fixedCandidate.afterSignalEnd: no new entries/increases; continue existing fixed risk/maturity exits and thesis invalid/reductions

buyHoldControl.initialAllocation: equal share of 12500, original costs and whole lots; first common legal input only

marketStates.up: at least 4/6 symbols pass the fixed trend
marketStates.down: at most 2/6 symbols pass the fixed trend
marketStates.highVolatility: mean annualized volatility20 >= 0.30; diagnostic only, not used for signals
marketStates.aggregation: group actual daily net return samples; never reset capital by state

diagnostics: cash days and no-positive-trend signal days
positive equal-six raw open-to-close basket days when candidate has no exposure; descriptive missed participation, not hypothetical achievable profit
daily exposure, rank changes, target changes, trade counts, fees, stop/maturity/thesis exit reasons
per-year and predefined previous-session state net changes, no resetting or dropping unfavorable days
executionGate: after original six comparison is complete, nontrading time, >=1024MB free; frozen source child <=512MB and <=20min per path; no current account changes
evidenceKind: already inspected historical exploration, not new blind or future validation
limitations: unknown corporate actions/first availability/tradability and public data revisions
raw open hypothetical fills; only raw 16:00 close valuation, no intraday extrema coverage
cash is not profitable performance and unsold end positions remain ownership
no threshold changes after path results; negative outcomes retained; no deployment from historical results
